'''Popapouch''' is a [[Rock]] type [[Tank]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Popa]] at 6 bronze stars/19 copies, and evolves into [[Popagrind]] at 18 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "The responsibility that comes with a baby isn't something that can be canceled or delayed. Whenever Popapouch wants to take a break, a gentle tug would serve as a reminder that this is a job for life."

Popapouch is a gold rarity Tatari.

== Evolution Trial ==
Popapouch's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 18 stars. To evolve it into [[Popapouch]] you need to complete the following two tasks:

* Feed Popapouch to increase stats 3 times.
* Play [[Treasure Hunt]] (Dig up treasure x70) or [[Cozy Farm]] (Use Fertilizer x4,200).

== Trivia ==
* Popapouch and its evolutions were added to the game on 10/72026 alongside [[Cactobodhi]] and [[Armavolve]].
